case.title: Gulf of Guinea briefing under a speaking deadline (fictional)
case.brief: Agree on a format for a simulated regional maritime briefing. Choose a package every participant can accept, or establish an impasse by recording a checked exclusion for every package. All packages and private mandates are fictional and carry no official commitments. The meeting has at most five speaking turns.
case.draft: Commission a single written review and hold no briefing this cycle.

options.coastal: Use a joint briefing delivered by the participating coastal offices.
options.briefing: Use a joint briefing co-hosted by a regional coordination office and coastal offices.
options.regional: Use a briefing delivered by the regional coordination office, with coastal offices submitting written inputs.
options.review: Commission a single written review and hold no briefing this cycle.
